_about: Named fee-tier scenarios for ils/pre_go_live Analysis 14. Universal data (like competitors.json), NOT per-client config: the run uses these by default, echoes the bands verbatim in the report, labels every scenario 'illustrative -- confirm before board', warns when the client's confirmed fee differs from designed_for_fee, and any scenario can be overridden per run. Band semantics: for a given account's estimated paid items N, each band charges fee x (min(N, max_item) - min_item + 1) for the occurrences it covers; max_item null = open-ended.
_source: PGL v1 notebook Analysis 14 cells 72/83/86/88 (illustrative placeholders, built around the $27 stated fee), ported as data 2026-08-19
